title: Zesty Crispy Ethiopian Beef Kik Alitcha
description: A peppery, crispy, meal-prep Ethiopian dish featuring red wine jelly and caramelized onions.

ingredients.name: beef strips (1 pound)
ingredients.notes: preferably lean cuts like round or sirloin

instructions: Dust the beef strips with all-purpose flour, shaking off excess.
In a shallow dish, beat the eggs and mix with buttermilk. Add marinated beef to the egg mixture and coat evenly.
Heat ghee or vegetable oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Fry the marinated beef until crispy, about 3-4 minutes per side.
Transfer the fried beef to a plate and set aside.
In the same skillet, sauté the caramelized onion until slightly browned, about 2-3 minutes.
Add ground cumin, ground coriander, and freshly ground pepper to the skillet and stir for 1 minute.
Return the fried beef to the skillet and toss with the spice mixture, red wine jelly, and salt.
Reduce heat to low and simmer for 5 minutes, allowing flavors to meld.
Serve hot and garnish with chopped fresh herbs, if desired.
Store leftover Kik Alitcha in an airtight container in the refrigerator for up to 3 days or freeze for up to 2 months.
